D03/BiF3 topology, Fm-3m, 16 atoms/cell. Reference lattice from 2012 Table S2 row 4 atomic volume converted to a cubic cell. Site occupancies are a documented maximal-order approximation enforcing the measured alloy composition, not a published refinement. Si fills 4a and occupies 0.08 of 4b; remaining sites are Fe. Superlattice intensities depend on unknown order and are approximate; measured peak positions/phase identity are the robust diffraction information.

<summary>Thermal equation choices</summary>

- **Debye temperature law:** integrated\_gruneisen

</details>

Diagnostic refits use unweighted pressure residuals; the source does not publish the numerical objective/weights or covariance. Published coefficients remain unchanged. The inherited 2012 protocol fits K0/K0\_prime to 32 room-temperature observations, then gamma0 to 66 high-temperature rows with the published static coefficients held fixed; the independent script reports both stages. The Fe–16Si Vinet alternative is a 2014 source-owned reanalysis of 2012 observations. Do not extrapolate the fixed structure or thermal EOS across phase coexistence boundaries.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Table S5 and Text S1, page 2; 2012 official Table S2, source worksheet row numbers retained.
- **Equation:** Main equations (1)-(2); standard Vinet replaces BM3 for the alternatives according to Text S1. Thermal pressure is referenced to 300 K using the integrated-Gruneisen Debye-temperature law.
- **V0:** Table S5 and Text S1, page 2: 6.799 cm^3/mol atoms; multiply by 16/0.602214076 for this cell. Measured and held fixed.
- **K0:** Table S5 and Text S1, page 2: 193.9 GPa. Fitted at 300 K then fixed in the thermal stage.
- **K0 prime:** Table S5 and Text S1, page 2: 4.91. Fitted at 300 K then fixed in the thermal stage.
- **Uncertainties:** Source-reported errors; confidence convention and covariance unspecified. Measured V0 errors remain recorded even when V0 is fixed.
- **Fit protocol:** Diagnostic refits use unweighted pressure residuals; the source does not publish the numerical objective/weights or covariance. Published coefficients remain unchanged. The inherited 2012 protocol fits K0/K0\_prime to 32 room-temperature observations, then gamma0 to 66 high-temperature rows with the published static coefficients held fixed; the independent script reports both stages.
- **Gamma0:** Table S5 and Text S1, page 2: 1.9 ± 0.07, fitted.
- **Q:** Fixed at one.
- **Theta0:** 417 K, fixed to the adopted iron value.
- **N:** One atom per fractional alloy formula; cell-to-formula normalization uses the explicit Z.
- **Tr:** 300 K thermal-energy subtraction.

### fischer\_2012\_table\_s2\_pvt

- **Description:** All 185 source observations, including excluded phases and pressure-marker observations; derived cell volumes supplement unchanged numeric source inputs.

The CSV contains factual measurements, not the source table image or layout. Sample temperatures already include the source gradient correction and must not be corrected again. D03 cell volumes equal the tabulated atomic molar volume times 16/0.602214076. The phase column is derived from which phase volumes are tabulated; B2\_volume\_only is not an assertion of a single-phase sample. KBr lattice uncertainties are standard errors across indexed d-spacings; pressure errors propagate marker lattice and temperature uncertainty. The 2012 source also identifies sample lattice errors as standard errors. The 2014 temperature errors combine 100 K analytical uncertainty, differences between the two sample sides and thickness correction; no confidence level is specified.
